lifecycle_stages.criterion: Exact baseline surface assigned once to a reviewed family.
Named raw-to-premise relation, scope, independent source inventory and residuals.
Versioned claim relation with checked theorem and declared assumptions.
Installed execution agrees with the complete request-bound native postcondition.
Separate positive, negative, tamper, missing-native and resource controls.
Each command forwards exact child claims and preserves failure receipts.
New runtime/runner identity, full release gates and actual head-bound deployment.
